source:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Work queue" as Queue {
        [*] --> Waiting
        Waiting --> Running: start
        Running --> [*]
    }
    classDef work fill:#D1FAE5,color:#065F46
    classDef work stroke:#34D399
    class Waiting,Running work
    style Queue fill:#F8FAFC,stroke:#64748B
    style Waiting fill:#FFFBEB,stroke:#FBBF24
